SELECT c.ClientID, c.LastName & ", " & c.FirstName AS ClientName, cb.FiscalYear, cb.AnnualBudget, Nz((SELECT SUM(csp2.AnnualEstCost) FROM tblClientServicePlan AS csp2 INNER JOIN tblClientServiceNeeds AS csn2 ON csp2.ClientServiceNeedID = csn2.ClientServiceNeedID WHERE csn2.ClientID = c.ClientID AND csp2.FiscalYear = cb.FiscalYear),0) AS TotalPlannedCost, [cb].[AnnualBudget]-Nz((SELECT SUM(csp3.AnnualEstCost) FROM tblClientServicePlan AS csp3 INNER JOIN tblClientServiceNeeds AS csn3 ON csp3.ClientServiceNeedID = csn3.ClientServiceNeedID WHERE csn3.ClientID = c.ClientID AND csp3.FiscalYear = cb.FiscalYear),0) AS RemainingBudget
FROM tblClients AS c INNER JOIN tblClientBudgets AS cb ON c.ClientID = cb.ClientID;

Sql.OriginalText:
SELECT p.ProviderID, p.ProviderName, csp.FiscalYear, sub.UniqueClientCount AS Clients, Sum(csp.HoursPerWeek * 52) AS Hours, Sum(csp.AnnualEstCost) AS TotalCost, FormatCurrency (Sum(csp.AnnualEstCost) / sub.UniqueClientCount) AS AvgPerClient
FROM (tblProviders AS p INNER JOIN (tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc INNER JOIN tblClientServicePlan AS csp ON psc.ProviderServiceCatalogID = csp.ProviderServiceCatalogID) ON p.ProviderID = psc.ProviderID) INNER JOIN (SELECT Dist.ProviderID, Count(Dist.ClientID) AS UniqueClientCount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT psc2.ProviderID, csn2.ClientID FROM tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc2 INNER JOIN (tblClientServicePlan AS csp2 INNER JOIN tblClientServiceNeeds AS csn2 ON csp2.ClientServiceNeedID = csn2.ClientServiceNeedID) ON psc2.ProviderServiceCatalogID = csp2.ProviderServiceCatalogID WHERE csp2.Status <> 'Cancelled')  AS Dist GROUP BY Dist.ProviderID)  AS sub ON p.ProviderID = sub.ProviderID
WHERE csp.Status <> 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY p.ProviderID, p.ProviderName, csp.FiscalYear, sub.UniqueClientCount;

FROM (tblProviders AS p INNER JOIN (tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc INNER JOIN tblClientServicePlan AS csp ON psc.ProviderServiceCatalogID = csp.ProviderServiceCatalogID) ON p.ProviderID = psc.ProviderID) INNER JOIN (SELECT Dist.ProviderID, Count(Dist.ClientID) AS UniqueClientCount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT psc2.ProviderID, csn2.ClientID FROM tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc2 INNER JOIN (tblClientServicePlan AS csp2 INNER JOIN tblClientServiceNeeds AS csn2 ON csp2.ClientServiceNeedID = csn2.ClientServiceNeedID) ON psc2.ProviderServiceCatalogID = csp2.ProviderServiceCatalogID WHERE csp2.Status <> 'Cancelled')  AS Dist GROUP BY Dist.ProviderID)  AS sub ON p.ProviderID = sub.ProviderID

CREATE TABLE [tblClientBudgets] (
    [ClientBudgetID] COUNTER,
    [ClientID] LONG NOT NULL,
    [FiscalYear] SHORT NOT NULL,
    [AnnualBudget] CURRENCY NOT NULL,
    [Notes] LONGTEXT,
    CONSTRAINT [PrimaryKey] PRIMARY KEY ([ClientBudgetID]),
    CONSTRAINT [rel_Client_Budgets] FOREIGN KEY ([ClientID]) REFERENCES [tblClients] ([ClientID]) ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE [tblClientServiceNeeds] (
    [ClientServiceNeedID] COUNTER,
    [ClientID] LONG NOT NULL,
    [ServiceID] LONG NOT NULL,
    [FiscalYear] SHORT NOT NULL,
    [Priority] SHORT DEFAULT 1,
    [DaysOfWeek] TEXT(20),
    [PreferredTimeStart] DATETIME,
    [PreferredTimeEnd] DATETIME,
    [HoursPerWeek] DOUBLE,
    [Notes] LONGTEXT,
    CONSTRAINT [PrimaryKey] PRIMARY KEY ([ClientServiceNeedID]),
    CONSTRAINT [rel_Client_ServiceNeeds] FOREIGN KEY ([ClientID]) REFERENCES [tblClients] ([ClientID]) ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT [rel_Service_ServiceNeeds] FOREIGN KEY ([ServiceID]) REFERENCES [tblServices] ([ServiceID]) ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE [tblClientServicePlan] (
    [ClientServicePlanID] COUNTER,
    [ClientServiceNeedID] LONG NOT NULL,
    [ProviderServiceCatalogID] LONG NOT NULL,
    [FiscalYear] SHORT NOT NULL,
    [HoursPerWeek] DOUBLE,
    [WeeklyCost] CURRENCY,

CREATE TABLE [tblClients] (
    [ClientID] COUNTER,
    [FirstName] TEXT(50) NOT NULL,

    [DateOfBirth] DATETIME NOT NULL,
    [SSNLast4] TEXT(4),
    [Gender] TEXT(1) DEFAULT "X",
    [Address1] TEXT(100),
    [Address2] TEXT(100),
    [City] TEXT(50),
    [StateCode] TEXT(2),
    [ZipCode] TEXT(10),
    [Phone] TEXT(20),
    [Email] TEXT(100),
    [EmergencyContactName] TEXT(100),
    [EmergencyContactPhone] TEXT(20),

    [Notes] LONGTEXT,
    CONSTRAINT [PrimaryKey] PRIMARY KEY ([ClientID]),
    CONSTRAINT [rel_State_Client] FOREIGN KEY ([StateCode]) REFERENCES [tlkpStates] ([StateCode]) ON UPDATE CASCADE
